questions.q: Which metric is undefined when an actual value is 0?
why: MAE has no division by the actual.
RMSE has no division by the actual.
Correct: MAPE divides by the actual value.

questions.q: Actual: 10, 20. Forecast: 14, 18. What is the MAE?
Actual: 10, 20. Forecast: 14, 18. What is the RMSE? Round to 2 decimals.
Actual: 5, 15, 30. Forecast: 10, 10, 30. What is the WAPE?
A retail team has many products with zero sales on some days. They need one number for all products. Which metric fits best?
why: Zero actuals make MAPE undefined or huge.
Correct: both work with zeros. WAPE weights by volume; MASE is scale-free.
sMAPE has trouble when actual and forecast are both zero, and small values dominate.

questions.q: Training series: 5, 7, 6, 8 (naive in-sample MAE = (2+1+2)/3 = 1.667). The test MAE is 2.5. What is the MASE?
questions.why: 2.5 / 1.667 = 1.5. The model is 50% worse than the naive method in-sample.
